'''Roasted yam''', also known as '''Ìṣu sisun''' in the Yoruba language, is a typical Nigerian street food mostly eaten as a snack. It is prepared just like roasted corn and eaten with groundnuts or ''boli'' (roasted plantain).

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Yam|Yam]]
*Ground pepper
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]

==Procedure==
#Cut yam into suitably-sized pieces, then peel them.
#Soak the yam in water overnight.
#Rinse the yam and [[Cookbook:Roasting|roast]] it, making sure all sides are deeply roasted.
#Serve the roasted yam with groundnuts or roasted plantain.
